source: runtime-enumeration.json for v7-secrets-cleanup-preview plus repo-present v7-sensitive-state-check

entries.purpose: Preview old generated profile artifacts and private-material filenames under a client artifact root.
state_reads: /root/v7-clients by default or provided root argument
sensitive_files_read: filenames for *.key, *private*, *preshared* under selected root; file contents are not read by script
entries.redaction_behavior: Does not print file contents, but prints full paths to private-material files; output is sensitive and should be operator-only.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute against live client artifact root in repo tests.
entries.special_safety: No apply tool invocation, no chmod/chown, no deletion, no /opt/v7 or /etc/v7 mutation. Preview can expose sensitive path names.

entries.purpose: Read-only sensitive-state metadata and dry-run permission/access mapper.
sensitive_files_read: metadata/stat only for token and policy files; SQLite identity DB opened read-only for schema/count summary
entries.redaction_behavior: Does not dump token contents or policy contents; emits metadata, exposure classification, and table counts.
entries.verification_requirement: python3 -m py_compile only; do not execute against live sensitive state in repo tests.
entries.special_safety: Repo-present validator is not part of live runtime enumeration; no VPS lineage gap is closed by this entry.
